source.author: stat
source.text: Thessalis haud aliter bello gavisa recenti, cui gentile nefas hominem renovare canendo.
source.text_original: Thessalis haud aliter bello gavisa recenti, / cui gentile nefas hominem renovare canendo.
source.text_english: The Thessalian woman, no less delighted by the recent war, for whom it is a racial crime to renew a human being by chanting.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: in scrobibus cruor et largus Phlegethontis aperti stagnat honos, saevoque vocat grandaeva tumultu Thessalis exanimes atavos magnaeque nepotem Pleiones.
reuse.text_original: in scrobibus cruor et largus Phlegethontis aperti / stagnat honos, saevoque vocat grandaeva tumultu / Thessalis exanimes atavos magnaeque nepotem / Pleiones.
reuse.text_english: in the pits, blood and the abundant glory of open Phlegethon lie stagnant, and in savage uproar aged Thessaly calls the lifeless ancestors and the descendant of great Pleione.
